items.text: Japan's decision whether to accept or reject the tentative agreement of the Japanese and American delegates to the London Naval Conference is fully expected to be rendered next Thursday. An extraordinary session of the cabinet has been called for the purpose of finally shaping Instructions to the delegation. There are strong and trustworthy indications tonight that the cabinet will authorize Reljiro Wakatsuki, Japan’s chief delegate, to accept an agreement approximating the terms laboriously formulated by Senator David A.
